dct_description_sm:
Features related to provincially tracked species and species at risk are not available as open data. Sensitive features are subject to licensing and approvals. Visit the Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources and Forestry website to get access to natural heritage information.
 
A station set up by biologists and technicians for the purpose of capturing information about one or more species. A data capture station collects or captures species data using a variety of different tools including remote cameras, hair snares, live traps, nets etc. Species Data Capture Stations are mapped as point locations with one point representing each station type. By extension, net drops from aircraft and chemical immobilization (dart) animal capture event points are included in this data class. Note: Fish-specific survey information (e.g. Creel Census) should be stored in the Aquatic Resource Area Survey Point data class.

dct_rights_sm: This data is subject to terms of use. Features related to provincially tracked species and species at risk are not available as open data. Sensitive features are subject to licensing and approvals. Visit the Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources and Forestry website (https://www.ontario.ca/page/get-natural-heritage-information) to get access to natural heritage information. Use Restrictions: Not for public viewing. Data will only be provided to named individuals identified by NHIC and OMNR Wildlife programs (e.g. Caribou, Wolverine). This class will be available to named users only who have undergone NHIC Data Sensitivity Training and have a data sharing agreement with NHIC. This class contains exact locations of Provincially Tracked Species (including SAR), and has medium sensitivity. Observer names will be stored in a secured table. Other than the name, no other personal information will be stored. Observer names are required for observation follow-up and information credibility (professional vs. amateur).
